description: This file contains an abstract test class 'RobolectricWizardFragmentTestCase' for testing fragments within a setup wizard activity using Robolectric framework. It also defines a nested static class 'TestableSetupWizardActivity' that provides a test-specific implementation of the wizard activity with a fragment adapter.

classes.name: RobolectricWizardFragmentTestCase
classes.description: An abstract test class for testing fragments in a setup wizard activity with Robolectric.

classes.name: TestableSetupWizardActivity
classes.description: A static inner class extending SetupWizardActivity, providing a fragment adapter for testing purposes.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Abstract method to create a fragment instance for testing.

methods.name: getCurrentFragment
methods.description: Returns the current fragment from the activity controller.

methods.name: createActivityController
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActivityController with a test fragment.

methods.name: createPagesAdapter
methods.description: Creates a FragmentStateAdapter that supplies the test fragment.
